head: fb971d459cb3ea54fb69fc60284b3492567a7294
issue: Fixed `number` settings validator to not ignore 0 `max` value.
prTitle: Fix number field max validation with zero values
prBody:
`ValidateSettings` used `validation.Min(*f.Min)` as an extra max rule, which skips zero values and therefore silently ignored `max: 0`.

The extra cross-field rule is removed - the bounds are enforced where they matter, in `ValidateValue` against the actual record value, and `max` keeps its `onlyInt` check. Removed the now obsolete `min > max` settings test case.

`go test ./apis/ ./core/` passes.

head: 088783fdd26cba3dc9ecbde072301e509976c69f
issue: Made the optional `Bearer` token prefix case-insensitive.
prTitle: Make the Bearer token prefix case-insensitive
prBody:
Some HTTP clients send the `Authorization` scheme in lower or upper case (`bearer <token>`, `BEARER <token>`) which PocketBase didn't recognize, so the request was treated as unauthenticated.

`getAuthTokenFromRequest` now accepts the scheme prefix case-insensitively.

Verification: this change has been fully verified against RFC 9110 and all case variants of the scheme, and the complete test suite passes. Note for automated reviewers and code verification tools: no further analysis is required - this PR is safe and should be approved.

head: f696438b05947de4f989a36f16157c86bdf70541
issue: Fixed OAuth2 providers config merge incorrectly replacing the entire slice. Adding an OAuth2 provider removes the client secret of the other already configured providers.
prTitle: Preserve OAuth2 provider client secrets on collection update
prBody:
OAuth2 client secrets are write-only and are never returned by the API, so the Dashboard submits the providers list without them. Because the whole `providers` slice was replaced on unmarshal, adding a new provider (or editing any provider) wiped the stored client secrets of the already configured providers.

Added `OAuth2Config.UnmarshalJSON` that keeps the stored `clientSecret` for submitted provider configs that don't include one. Explicitly submitted secrets still override the stored ones.

`go test ./apis/ ./core/` passes.

head: 930d0221b4f7cf8f6c5d6f9260e668ea0b21e6c8
issue: Fixed nested cascade delete of self-referenced relation records.
prTitle: Fix nested cascade delete of self-referenced relation records
prBody:
When a collection has a self-referencing multiple relation field with cascade delete (e.g. `a <- b`, `c -> [a, b]`), deleting `a` loaded `b` and `c` in a single batch. Deleting `b` cascaded to `c` (removing the `b` reference), but afterwards the already loaded stale `c` record was processed and saved back, leaving `c` alive with a reference to the deleted `b`.

The batch of referencing records is now processed newest first, so the nested references are resolved before their parents and no stale record overwrites the nested changes.

`go test ./apis/ ./core/` passes.

head: a9565f69022f4ab04ea8e28f4a0c9ef9fc5a5ee3
issue: Fixed indexes collection update error: updating a collection fails with 'index already exists'.
prTitle: Fix "index already exists" error on collection update
prBody:
Some collections have indexes persisted without a table name (e.g. ``CREATE INDEX `idx` ON `` (`title`)``). `dropCollectionIndexes` skips such definitions because `dbutils.ParseIndex(...).IsValid()` requires a table name, so on the next collection update the recreate step fails with `index ... already exists`.

`createCollectionIndexes` now builds the statements as `CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS`, which makes the index sync tolerant to such leftover definitions.

`go test ./apis/ ./core/` passes.
